catalog_unit_note: A row here is one imputed SV genotype: a variant under one resolution mode. 1,732 of the 8,792 coordinates were resolved under more than one mode, and each mode carries its own imputation accuracy and its own carrier frequency, so each is its own predictor. The manuscript's 11,129 counts something else again - rows of the CDR scan substrate, one per variant x mode x ensemble x weight strategy, over 6,041 distinct coordinates, all of which are present here.

layers.label: Expression QTL
layers.why: cis at q<=0.05; reproduces the published 86 eGenes / 74 sGenes / 141 unique genes, plus a derived 0.05<q<=0.10 band of 46 gene-rows over 42 SVs; trans-only rows excluded (0 survive the R7 controls)

layers.label: Splicing QTL
layers.why: cis at q<=0.05; reproduces the published 86 eGenes / 74 sGenes / 141 unique genes, plus a derived 0.05<q<=0.10 band of 46 gene-rows over 42 SVs; trans-only rows excluded (0 survive the R7 controls)

layers.label: Methylation QTL
layers.why: 418 same-chromosome CpG associations at q < 0.01 over 42 SVs and 376 CpGs, drawn on 67 catalogue entries; 360 lie within 5 Mb, where deletion dosage marks lower methylation at 288 of 296 CpGs (97.3%) across 18 of 20 deletion loci. 68 SVs entered the scan. One deletion clears the whole-scan maximum-statistic calibration at 0.05.

layers.label: Centromere dip region
layers.why: 38 (SV, phenotype) records over 26 SVs on 7 chromosomes, every one study-wide significant at 5.62e-07 or within twice it: 23 primary and 15 in the second band. 12 clear the array-endpoint and ancestry gates, all on chr8 within 213.6 kb; the other 26 carry the quantity their signal tracks. 38 rows, both controls agree with the gate.

layers.label: All of Us disease PheWAS
layers.why: q<0.05: 170 associations over 61 SV predictors and 27 diseases (chr16 134); plus the section's 85 suggestive associations at 0.05<=q<0.10. One cross-ancestry model per phenotype; BH within predictor tier over 26,101,183 tests, and the negative-control tier contributes 0 of the 170

tier_note: Primary is each section's headline significance. Suggestive is its second band where the section states one (All of Us 0.05 <= q < 0.10; methylation QTL robust in one SNP panel of two) and, for the e/sQTL layers only, a 0.05 < q <= 0.10 band derived with the same filter the manuscript uses at 0.05 - that band is derived here.
fst_note: max pairwise F_ST on all 10,705 SVs (10694 carry a value), plus directly-called HPRC allele frequencies by super-population; catalog mean 0.0164, 0.58% above 0.15, max 0.580

ancestry.note: Each cell was re-tested inside every ancestry stratum. The Researcher Workbench released the full grid for these 255 cells in all six strata, so a stratum without an estimate is either a cell with fewer than 20 cases or one where the imputed predictor carries no usable variance there; the chip says which.

ancestry_note: 1530 per-stratum records over 255 cells; 920 carry an estimate against 204 in the prior release, including 172 in EAS/SAS/MID which had none; 188 blanks are fewer than 20 cases and 422 are a predictor with no information there

null_ext.label: Negative control
null_ext.note: posterior inclusion below 0.01 for all 464 traits in the summary-level scan, so carrying no prior signal

tracks_note: 60 bins x 23 chromosomes of coverage-weighted 5mC over 60-326 haplotypes, and 21597 dips; median dips per centromere 4.0; dip position 6.1x more variable between individuals than within a haplotype; dip density tracks the methylation trough at median r = -0.93; 3 chromosome(s) flagged for an unstable positional frame and 5 where CHM13 is an atypical haplotype (chr14, chr15, chr21, chr3, chr4); decomposed into 5 ancestry strata that partition the cohort exactly on every chromosome (haplotype-chromosomes: AFR 1431, AMR 1036, EAS 1005, EUR 528, SAS 806)
ld_note: 188 individuals over 23 chromosomes; 10,691 catalog SVs and 40,872 pericentromeric SNPs on both GRCh38 centromere flanks, the complete substrate; 26,669 columns below MAF 0.05 are marked thin; 540,007 of 7,656,648 SNP calls were open and carry their variant's mean dosage, recomputed here and agreeing with the source to 8.9e-16; 7 flanks re-anchored outward past a callability gap; r recomputed from these genotypes reproduces the reference panels on 9,457 shared variants and 989,268 cells, SNP and cross blocks included, to better than 1e-06

floors.note: The upstream imputation summaries are already filtered, so these controls can only raise a floor, never lower it. Raising cross-validated R-squared to 0.30 reproduces the manuscript's strict imputability tier, which is the set the population-differentiation section reasons on.
